$comment: Thresholds for flagging a possible new conflict from abnormal news volume. Detection NEVER asserts a conflict — it opens a candidate for human confirmation.
$countedCategoriesComment: Scoring total conflict-coded volume flagged protest waves (Nepal, Morocco, Romania) as emerging conflicts on 13 of 20 backtested days. A new armed conflict appears as armed clashes, so violent_unrest and violent_repression are tracked for display but excluded from detection.
$triggerComment: A new armed conflict sustains for weeks; a protest wave or a single grim news week does not. Requiring 4 elevated days inside a 7-day window is what separates them. excludeRecentDays must be at least sustainedWindowDays, otherwise the flare-up lands inside its own baseline and hides itself — this is enforced in code.
